name: Mavis
says: Good heavens, love, is this 'Big Steak and Ale Pie' supposed to be a dish for us? It's thick enough to choke a bull! And why did you go and build another kiosk just so Pea could stare at it while I tried to sip my tea in peace?
wants: A proper lace doily for under those rough bits of paper tearing into my table!
